name: Orange County Sheriff Teen Academy
what_you_do: Spend 5 days in a summer workshop on the Sheriff's Department. You tour the police academy, crime lab and coroner's office. You see K-9, helicopter and harbor patrol shows.
pay_detail: Free. You earn community service hours.
deadline_text: In 2026 there were two sessions: June 8 to 12 and July 20 to 24. Sign-up closed June 2 and July 14. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: To join the interest list, email TeenAcademy@ocsheriff.gov. In 2026, the flyer said to email your form to the same address.
notes: Space is limited. The service hours can count toward high school graduation rules. The flyer lists Community Engagement at 714-647-4141 for questions.
